notes.title: Dummy Devblog: Closed Beta
notes.content:
Ahoy there!

Public playtest is now up! Feel free to request access to it in the game's store page and we'll give it to you as soon as possible. 

Also, we'll be releasing Devblogs of the whole process behind the scenes of making Dummy Pirates, starting today. 

What we want to showcase this time are our brand, new and deadly bots, and our sparkling, pointy and shiny rock formations within the map. 

Starting with the bots, we created them with the intention of them being able to hold their own against human players, so that when you have bots in your team or play against them, it feels like a decent challenge and not just an AI filling in a position just so it isn't empty. 

Bots right now are capable of: 


Facing and attacking enemy ships
Rotate while moving
Target prioritization
Obtain items
Return to base
Use skills
Fight neutral monsters
Fetching chests while avoiding combat
Buy items


There are still some fixes pending for them, but we feel quite satisfied with the current state of the difficulty of fighting against them. 

On the other point, we've been working on polishing the rock formations of Chromatica found within the map: 

https://i.imgur.com/07AcJZf.png

https://i.imgur.com/zywFed8.jpeg

Stay tuned for the next devblog! See ye on the sea, arr, mates!
